### Cut Off Your Hand: How Far Will You Go to Save Your Soul?
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/cut-off-your-hand
Passage: Matthew 18:7-9
Points:
- Tolerating habitual sin reveals a dangerous loss of reverence for God's holiness.
- Jesus gives sobering warnings because hell is a real and terrifying judgment.
- Cutting off hands and tearing out eyes is metaphorical yet demands radical measures to remove stumbling blocks.
- Believers must ruthlessly eliminate whatever habits, relationships, or pursuits cause them to stumble.
- Cultivating a healthy fear of the Lord protects the soul and leads to lasting joy.

### PowerPoint - Aug. 7, 2007
Author: PowerPoint Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-aug-7-2007-11550323.html
Passage: Luke 17:3-4
Points:
- Harboring ongoing anger and bitterness can only be resolved through intentional forgiveness.
- Bitterness resembles a hidden root that must be identified and pulled up.
- Forgiving repeated offenses requires faithful obedience rather than waiting to feel like it.
- Trusting God involves believing He can use relational hurt to refine Christian character.
- Biblical forgiveness means freely surrendering the right to hate or punish an offender.
